title: elatostema cyrtandrifolium
intro: Elatostema cyrtandrifolium, commonly known as the Asian Polypody or Elatostema, is a species of flowering plant in the family Urticaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce swelling, alleviate pain, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Elatostema cyrtandrifolium include anti-bacterial, anti-fungal, and anti-viral activities, making it useful for treating infections and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
